It forms a closed loop of plan → validate → apply → rollback."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"The design is inspired by the open-source prime-agent from Prime Intellect, a self-improving coding "},{"id":"p5s2","text":"gn is inspired by the open-source prime-agent from Prime Intellect, a self-improving coding harness."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Capabilities"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"A single npm package (`dsh-continual-harness`) takes effect through the following extension points o"},{"id":"p7s2","text":" package (`dsh-continual-harness`) takes effect through the following extension points once mounted:"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"| Capability | Mechanism |"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"| State projection (inject harness context each step) | `agent/pre-step` waterfall listener; increme"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"ntal injection when the content digest changes |
| Review and automatic refinement | `session/event`"},{"id":"p9s3","text":" listener on turn interval / compaction end; runs LLM review → plan → apply automatically |
| Manual"},{"id":"p9s4","text":" refinement tool | Registers the `harness_refine` tool (directly callable by the LLM, supports rollb"},{"id":"p9s5","text":"ack) |

| Memory lifecycle | Manual archiv"},{"id":"p9s7","text":"e/unarchive/pin through refinement metadata; archived entries are hidden from injection and skill ma"},{"id":"p9s8","text":"terialization |

| Session wrap-up | Optional `harness_wrapup` tool gives mechanical keep/promote/archive advic"},{"id":"p9s11","text":"e; promotion is copy-only and conflicts return a deterministic error |

| Explicit A/B benchmark | Single `harness_benchmark` a"},{"id":"p9s14","text":"ction tool: fixed frozen cases, pre-refinement reference snapshots, and same-round reference/candida"},{"id":"p9s15","text":"te A/B runs with code-owned decisions |"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## Architecture"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"### Data layout"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"- **Skills are real dsh skills:** applied skill edits materialize as `<name>/SKILL.md` bundles (with"},{"id":"p14s2","text":" provenance metadata) under `Config.skillsDir`, kept in sync by deletes/rollbacks without touching u"},{"id":"p14s3","text":"ser-owned skills in the same directory."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"### Experience Solidification Protocol (ESP)"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"The Experience Solidification Protocol (ESP) is the **protocol surface** of this capability set, dec"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"oupled from this package's implementation:"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"| Protocol element | Carrier | Description |"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"| Experience state schema | `harness_state.json` (`schemaVersion: 1`) | Four kinds of entries — `pro"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"mpt / memory / skill / subagent` — each with `id / kind / version / content / updatedAt` |
| Experie"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"nce history | `refinements.jsonl` (append-only) | One `RefinementResult` record per apply/rollback; "},{"id":"p18s4","text":"rollback by id |

[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"### dsh version compatibility"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"Verified against dsh `0.2.0-rc.2` — typecheck, lint, build, the full 651-test suite, and a real prof"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"ile boot on the 0.2.0-rc.2 runtime — and against `0.1.7-rc.1` with the same suite. One peer range ad"},{"id":"p25s3","text":"mits every runtime from `0.1.5-rc.1` through `0.2.0-rc.2` (`>=0.1.5-rc.1 <0.2.1`), because that rang"},{"id":"p25s4","text":"e is exactly what dsh evaluates in its plugin/runtime compatibility gate before mounting a plugin or"},{"id":"p25s5","text":" a profile bundle. dsh `0.1.7` introduced that gate: when a plugin's `@deepseek-ai/dsh*` peers do no"},{"id":"p25s6","text":"t satisfy the running version, its profile bundle is skipped, so widening the range is what keeps on"},{"id":"p25s7","text":"e source loadable on both the older and the current runtime. Since dsh `0.1.2-alpha.3` no longer pro"},{"id":"p25s8","text":"vides `@deepseek-ai/dsh-home-paths` inside the profile bundle, the plugin declares it as a hard depe"},{"id":"p25s9","text":"ndency; `@deepseek-ai/dsh-invariants` is used for types only (dev-time) and is not required at runti"},{"id":"p25s10","text":"ncy; `@deepseek-ai/dsh-invariants` is used for types only (dev-time) and is not required at runtime."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"## Known Limitations and Deferred Work"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"- No end-to-end tests with a real LLM: `completeViaAgent` depends on the loaded `llm` capability and"},{"id":"p27s2","text":" provider/model configuration; tests cover the planning/review paths with a stub `Complete`. Real e2"},{"id":"p27s3","text":"e requires `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`.
- `compaction/end` is not part of the plugin's type union; the driver"},{"id":"p27s4","text":" triggers it via string comparison after type narrowing, and the gate is silently skipped when the c"},{"id":"p27s5","text":"ompaction capability is not loaded.
- Projection dedup is an in-process `WeakMap<Agent, digest>`: th"},{"id":"p27s6","text":"e first step after a session restart re-injects (stateless and idempotent, but one extra injection)."},{"id":"p27s7","text":"
- Concurrent writes are last-writer-wins: multiple processes refining the same directory concurrent"},{"id":"p27s8","text":"ly may overwrite each other; baseline conflict detection during planning can only catch read-after-w"},{"id":"p27s9","text":"rite races, not serialize them.
- A failed automatic refinement degrades silently (only logged) and "},{"id":"p27s10","text":"never interrupts the session.
- A content-shrink guard (rejecting updates that shrink an entry too f"},{"id":"p27s11","text":"ar in one commit) is a planned follow-up and is not yet implemented; today only `maxEntryGrowth` cap"},{"id":"p27s12","text":"s how much an update may grow an entry.
- A dedicated governance tool entry is deferred."}],"truncated":true}
